# {{ site.title }}

> {{ home.description }}

tutuf is a small team of three product engineers based in Sofia, Bulgaria, building, evolving and looking after software that businesses depend on since 2007. We work with only a few clients at a time, so the people you talk to are the people who do the work.

Most of our work begins in one of four situations:

- A proven process has outgrown spreadsheets and workarounds.
- Useful systems still need people to bridge the gaps.
- A useful prototype has become real software.
- An important system needs a responsible team again.

Facts about tutuf:

- Legal name: ТУТУФ ЕООД, registered in Sofia, Bulgaria.
- We build web applications with Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and connect them to the services around them - payment providers, supplier feeds, marketplaces. If a system is built with something else, we are still open to it.
- Every engagement starts with a focused assessment, usually 1–2 weeks at a fixed price, continues in useful increments, and can move on to ongoing care and development with reserved monthly capacity.
- AI agents write, test and change much of our code. Every change that reaches a client's system is reviewed by one of us, and we remain responsible for it.
- We are not the right team for companies that need one supplier for all of their technology and design. When an affordable ready-made product already does the job, we recommend it instead of building.
- We do not work with companies whose business involves gambling, tobacco or weapons, or with companies built on exploitation, harmful addiction or serious environmental harm.
- Contact: hi@tutuf.com, in English or Bulgarian. The first conversation is free.
